description: Mine where your audience actually talks (reviews, Reddit, YouTube comments, communities) and produce two brand files, audience.md (segments, awareness, jobs-to-be-done, watering holes) and voc.md (verbatim pain/desire/objection language with sources). Use it before positioning or copy work, when launching into a new market, or when copy keeps missing because nobody knows how customers actually describe the problem.
